about_the_game:
Fantasy Gatekeeper is a fantasy simulation game where you take on the role of a city guard, responsible for inspecting adventurers seeking entry. Analyze their documents, search their belongings, and enforce ever-changing laws. Some will try to bribe you, others will attempt to deceive you, and a few may hold secrets that could alter the fate of the city.

Will you be a loyal enforcer of the law, a corrupt official, or someone who uncovers hidden truths? Every decision shapes your reputation, wealth, and the world around you.

Key Features:

  • Inspect and Judge: Examine adventurers' papers, belongings, and behavior to determine who enters the city.

  • Evolving Laws & Restrictions: New decrees and changing policies challenge your judgment each day.

  • Moral Dilemmas: Take bribes, confiscate items, or follow strict orders—your choices define your fate.

  • Deep Progression System: Earn gold and spend it to unlock tools, resources, and access to hidden knowledge.

  • Uncover Secrets: Discover hidden conspiracies, forbidden artifacts, and the true power struggles within the city.

Hold the gates. Make your choice. Shape the city's future.
